WebSurfer clicked pause, which halted the only source of the visual evidence the task needed. Afterward it only scrolled the comments and never resumed playback or captured frames, so no bird-species count was ever made. The orchestrator's repeated re-requests (steps 18 and 22) could not recover from this, and the run ended with an incorrect answer of 2.
